title: Sparkly pretzel
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="pretzelBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E0A54F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B87426"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFF7A8">
    <path d="M18 20 L20 26 L26 28 L20 30 L18 36 L16 30 L10 28 L16 26 Z"/>
    <path d="M82 16 L83.5 21 L88.5 22.5 L83.5 24 L82 29 L80.5 24 L75.5 22.5 L80.5 21 Z"/>
    <path d="M86 62 L87.5 67 L92.5 68.5 L87.5 70 L86 75 L84.5 70 L79.5 68.5 L84.5 67 Z"/>
    <path d="M14 60 L15.5 65 L20.5 66.5 L15.5 68 L14 73 L12.5 68 L7.5 66.5 L12.5 65 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- small dots sparkle colors -->
  <g fill="#A8E6FF">
    <circle cx="30" cy="12" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="88" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="42" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="44" r="2"/>
  </g>
  <!-- pretzel body: three loops, stroke-based knot -->
  <g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- outer loop shadow/light pass -->
    <path d="M50 62 C30 82 12 72 16 56 C19 43 34 40 42 50 C48 57 46 64 50 62 C54 60 52 53 58 50 C66 40 81 43 84 56 C88 72 70 82 50 62 Z"
          stroke="#C98333" stroke-width="15"/>
    <!-- main lit pass -->
    <path d="M50 62 C30 82 12 72 16 56 C19 43 34 40 42 50 C48 57 46 64 50 62 C54 60 52 53 58 50 C66 40 81 43 84 56 C88 72 70 82 50 62 Z"
          stroke="url(#pretzelBody)" stroke-width="11"/>
  </g>
  <!-- salt crystals -->
  <g fill="#FFFDF0">
    <rect x="24" y="52" width="3" height="3" rx="0.8" transform="rotate(15 25 53)"/>
    <rect x="33" y="66" width="3" height="3" rx="0.8" transform="rotate(-20 34 67)"/>
    <rect x="68" y="66" width="3" height="3" rx="0.8" transform="rotate(25 69 67)"/>
    <rect x="74" y="52" width="3" height="3" rx="0.8" transform="rotate(-10 75 53)"/>
    <rect x="48" y="74" width="3" height="3" rx="0.8" transform="rotate(30 49 75)"/>
    <rect x="47" y="46" width="2.6" height="2.6" rx="0.7" transform="rotate(-15 48 47)"/>
  </g>
  <!-- specular highlights -->
  <g stroke="#FFF0C9" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.85">
    <path d="M22 58 C23 53 27 49 32 47"/>
    <path d="M76 58 C75 53 71 49 66 47"/>
  </g>
</svg>
